surfaces.coverage: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 39.51 km effective diameter (catalog ±0.69 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size supplies a volume-scale approximation. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative. Hanuš2016 Table2 reports10 dense lightcurves from one apparition and366 sparse points. Two poles remain; model1218 is representative. Limited dense apparition coverage is a model limitation and no high-resolution terrain is claimed. The thermal scale is approximate. Convex inversion supplies broad outline without resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point in 3D; source barycentric radius and normal. No radial branch selection.
